digest_policy.git_blob_oid: Git blob object ID SHA-1; repository object identity
digest_policy.raw_file_sha256: SHA-256 over exact Git blob bytes
digest_policy.line_endings: LF and CRLF are byte-significant. No normalization. Git blob bytes are canonical; never hash an autocrlf-converted Windows worktree as if it were the blob. A separate worktree measurement must hash raw bytes and record its newline form.
digest_policy.commit_tree: Every entry records the exact source repository, commit SHA, root tree SHA, relative path and present/absent state.

IPD_primary_qe_coordinate.use: Qualified-tree IPD bytes for all 32 IPD entries, the 9 criteria references and the re-measured Gate 3 anchors. 0 commits behind IPD main at regeneration.

IPD_broker_alias_compatibility_coordinat.use: Raw-source build inputs compiled by frontend/tsconfig.broker-import.json into .cache/broker-import for the live DB-C1 /broker-holdings preview. Interim, guarded; NOT a modernization of the alias.

IRR_qe_consumer.use: Exact qualification consumer code pin for the 24 IRR entries; measured at this commit and re-verified byte-identical at the freeze-publication merge commit.
